description: Byte-lock for the GRADED DIMENSIONS of the lattice VOA V_L over the in-tree E8 lattice (E8Lattice = Construction A over AdinkraCode.generator). dim (V_L)_n are the coefficients of theta_L(q) / eta(q)^8 with the q^(-1/3) prefactor stripped. Integer-only: every value is an exact int64 recorded as BOTH a decimal string and a zero-padded 16-digit big-endian hex string (hex-in-JSON per no-binary-in-proof-lineage; no float ever enters this path). SCOPE: this file locks a sequence of integers. It does NOT assert that this repo implements vertex operators, the VOA axioms, the Frenkel-Kac isomorphism, the affine E8 action, or anything about the Monster. Zhu's modular-invariance theorem quantifies over C2-cofinite VOAs; we have no VOA, so modularity is NOT claimed here.
generatedBy: src/Core/LatticeVoa.fs (F# is the generating oracle / treaty)

routeL.how: thetaByEnumeration (depth-first point count over Construction A from AdinkraCode.generator) * etaPowMinus8Geometric (8-colour partition recurrence)
routeL.reads: the in-tree binary code and nothing else

routeM.how: eisensteinE4 (1 + 240 * sum sigma_3(m) q^m, divisor sums) * etaPowMinus8Pentagonal (Euler pentagonal expansion, three squarings, series inversion)
routeM.reads: number theory only; no lattice point is enumerated

published.how: the published external reference sequence, transcribed

cube.how: the convolution cube of the graded dimensions must equal the coefficients of the modular function j
cube.reads: OEIS A000521 terms (offset -1) 0..8, retrieved 2026-08-15 - a datum neither route consumed

independenceCaveat: The two routes' NUMERATORS are genuinely disjoint (lattice point counting vs. divisor sums, sharing no input). The two routes' DENOMINATORS are the same mathematical object computed by disjoint algorithms - algorithmic independence, not derivational. The cube lane is independent of both. Stated so the falsifier is not oversold.

Conway & Sloane, SPLAG ch. 4-5 - Construction A; the theta series of E8

thetaSeries.note: theta_L indexed by m = (x.x)/4, the E8-normalised half-norm; theta[1] = 240 is the in-tree kissing number. Both routes must produce this.

etaPowMinus8.note: prod (1 - q^k)^(-8); partitions into parts of 8 colours. Both routes must produce this.
